summary: mount_facts options: device and fstype fnmatch filters, include_aggregate_mounts for duplicate mount points, mount_binary fallback, and on_timeout behavior.
questions: How do I filter mount facts by filesystem type?
What happens when two mounts share a mount point?
How do I skip hung mounts instead of failing?

answer_card.title: mount_facts parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `fstypes`, `devices`: fnmatch filters
- `include_aggregate_mounts`: return `aggregate_mounts` (null warns on duplicates)
- `mount_binary` (mount): fallback when no dynamic source; `null` disables
- `on_timeout`: `error` (default), `warn`, `ignore`
